opportunities.description:
### 赏金平台 / Platform
GitHub

### 原始链接 / Source URL
https://github.com/Grainlify/grainlify-bounty-agent/issues/1

### 漏洞描述 / Description
Record the real network fee in the ledger, not only the capped estimate

**The problem**

When the agent pays for inference over x402, the Solana network fee is most of what the call costs — in our measurements a paid call cost $0.002031, of which $0.002004 was the network fee. So the fee is the number most worth getting right.

The signer already knows exactly what the fee was: `res.feeLamports`, taken from the confirmed transaction. It converts that to micro-USD using `solUsdCeilingPrice`, a deliberately high fixed SOL price ($400) chosen so the budget can never under-count spend.

That conversion is the only thing kept. `inference_calls` stores `fee_micro` and no lamports, so the ledger reports a conservative estimate and the exact figure is thrown away.

**Where in the code**

- `services/signer/src/signer.ts` — `PayResult` carries `fee_lamports`; look for `lamportsToMicroCeil(res.feeLamports, ...)`.
- `packages/x402/src/client.ts` — the settle call that records the payment drops `fee_lamports`.
- `db/migrations/` — add a new forward-only migrat

opportunities.description:
> **Severity:** Medium · **Component:** `paraloom-wallet` · **Reward tier:** up to $150 USDC
> **Status:** Reproduced locally · No live chain touched · Researcher-owned dummy keys

## Summary

The Activity feed offers a **Dismiss** action on any private-swap row that is still "pending",
and its detail sheet tells the user *"Your funds are safe in your shielded balance. Dismissing
only clears this row."* (`src/popup/Home.tsx:1180-1184`). `dismissSwapOutput`
(`lib/paraloom/swapOutputs.ts:51-55`) then **deletes the row — and with it
`freshSecretKeyHex`, the only copy of the fresh address's secret key.**

That safety claim only holds when the row is one the reconciler genuinely could not account for.
It is **false** in a second, reachable state: the withdraw settled but the swap leg *and every
automatic resume attempt* failed, so the withdrawn assets are **still sitting at the fresh
address**. `reconcileSwapOutputs` leaves a failed resume and a genuinely-unresolved row in the
*same* "pending" state (`lib/paraloom/swapReconcile.ts:117-123` vs `:148`), so the UI cannot tell
them apart and offers the destructive Dismiss on both — destroying the only means of recovering
the funds.

opportunities.title: check_contrast.py: add --json output and a CI action that fails on contrast regressions
opportunities.description:
## Problem
`check_contrast.py --matrix` is the one part of tastemaker that is a computation rather than judgment, but its output is human-readable text only. That means nothing downstream can consume it: a project can't fail CI when a palette change breaks a text-safe pairing, and the agent has to re-parse prose to update the style lock.

## Proposal
1. Add a `--json` flag to `skills/tastemaker/scripts/check_contrast.py` (all three modes: pair, `--palette`, `--matrix`). For `--matrix`, emit every pair with its ratio and class (`text-safe` / `ui-safe` / `decorative`), plus the grouped legal pairings.
2. Exit non-zero when a pairing that the style lock marks as text-safe drops below 4.5:1.
3. Ship a small composite GitHub Action (e.g. `.github/actions/contrast-check`) that reads the palette from `.tastemaker/style-lock.md` and runs the check on PRs.

## Acceptance
- `--json` output is stable and documented in the script's docstring.
- Existing text output is unchanged without the flag.
- A PR that lowers a text-safe pair below 4.5:1 fails the action with the offending pair named.

---

opportunities.description:
> 这是本轮评估（`docs/maintainer/strategic-assessment-2026-09-18.md`）得出的**唯一一个**能改变结论的缺口：
> 仓库里所有"装了 MisakaNet 的 agent 会更少重复犯错"的说法，目前**没有任何一项测量**支持。
> 现有的两个 benchmark 是占位符（`bench/self-healing/run_benchmark.py:137-140` 里
> `success = with_misakanet  # Placeholder — real implementation needed`；`scripts/lesson_reuse_bench.py:4`
> import 一个不存在的 `agents.YourAgent`），README 的 21%→43% 量的是"课程修复命令关键词有没有出现在**模型回复文本**里"
> （`scripts/benchmark_workers_ai.py:129-152` 的 `score_response()`），而维护者自己的评估写着
> 「我们对遵循率**没有任何测量**」（`docs/maintainer/setup-value-assessment-2026-09-16.md:73-74`）。

## 要收集什么

**任务级的对照数据**：同一个 agent、同一套任务，装 MisakaNet 与不装各跑一遍，按**任务是否成功**评分。

## 硬性验收条件（不降标准；缺任意一条即不接受）

1. **先写规则再跑**：任务集、每题的"成功判据"（测试通过 / 文件状态 / 退出码）、跑法，**先在 issue 里贴出来**，
   跑完不许改。改过的提交另起一条。
2. **环境写全**：OS 与版本、助手（Claude Code / Codex / …）与版本、Node 与 Python 版本、模型名与版本、
   任务集里每条任务的来源。缺任何一项即不接受。
3. **两臂对称**：同一模型、同一任务集、同一机器；"装"这一臂必须由 `npx @misaka-net/misakanet-setup`
   真实安装（附 `--report` 输出），"不装"这一臂必须是干净家目录（附同一份 `--report` 输出以证明没装）。
4. **评分对象是任务结果**，不是回复文本：不允许用"回复里出现了课程关键词"当成功判据
   （那正是现有 benchmark 的问题）。
5. **提交原始日志**，不接受人工摘要：两臂每一题的完整 transcript 与完整 stderr（可以脱敏密钥/路径，
   但要保留工具调用的时间线）。日志里必须能看出**哪一次工具调用**是 `misakanet_search`（或它缺席）。

opportunities.title: durability(hosted journal): concurrent appends + unbounded growth need bounds (follow-up to #4240)
opportunities.description:
## Summary

#4240 turned the hosted lane's JSONL rebuild journal **on** (per-graph files under
`TORTOISE_EVENT_LOG_BASE_DIR`, written by `event_log.append`). Two properties of
that write surface were acceptable while only single-writer CLI lanes used it;
the hosted lane makes them live:

1. **Concurrent appends are not serialized.** `EventLog.append` is a bare
   `open(path, "a")` + one `write()`. The hosted API runs its graph writes on a
   bounded threadpool (`_graph_offload` / `asyncio.to_thread`), so two requests
   can append to the same per-graph file concurrently. `read_all` tolerates a
   *torn trailing* line but **raises on mid-file corruption** — an interleave is
   not a torn tail, and a raised parse kills the recovery tool the journal
   exists for (`rebuild_all` / `recover_from_log`).
2. **Growth is unbounded.** Every write appends a full snapshot line (a
   `PointAdded` payload now carries the embedding, #5004) with no rotation,
   compaction, or retention. On the per-machine `/data` volume this grows with
   every capture, turn, and entity write.

Both are pre-existing properties of the #548 journal family

opportunities.title: Intake and document reads: the root email is parsed twice and whole files are copied with ToArray
opportunities.description:
## What happens

Every root `.eml` read runs `MimeMessage.LoadAsync` twice (display reader, then source reader) and copies the message bytes, and the Sent evidence poll parses each new MIME twice. Whole-file `ToArray()` copies sit on the intake source download (then again in the Source and Image pages and the MCP streaming endpoint, so a file is held three times), on retained asset bytes at eight sites, on blob upload payloads, on the OCR buffer, on the original report and estimate import reads, on the export archive, on the Principal API body (3-5 times the body size near the 42 MB cap), and on MSG and CFB extraction. The dominant full-page raster is extracted twice in PDF classification and the asset loop.

## Expected

One parse and one buffer per read: pre-sized buffers exposed through `GetBuffer`, `Results.Bytes(ReadOnlyMemory<byte>)` on the MCP endpoint with range processing kept, `MemoryMarshal.TryGetArray` where `PageModel.File` needs `byte[]`, and the shared `ContentStream` helper. Opus rates each as a few ms and one LOH allocation per file; aggregate volume is low (17 Source/Image downloads, 5 uploads, about 107 UnifiedWork runs in 14 days), so this is CPU and memory hygi
